title: Kaalamellam Kaathal Vaazhga
desc: A mutual passion for music attracts Kausalya and Jeeva to each other, via phone calls. Over time, their connection grows stronger, and their frequent conversations spark a love story between them.

title: Anbe Anbe
desc: Cheenu and Shiva are cousins who live in a joint family. Trouble brews in their lives when their relative arrives with their daughter, Vishali, and both the men fall in love with her.

title: Kadal Meengal
desc: A fisherman returns from sea after being presumed dead. However, unaware that his lover has given birth to their son, he marries another after failing to find her.

title: Oruvan
desc: A fireman is devastated after losing his family to an unfortunate accident. However, he decides to move on in life and later finds solace in nurturing an orphan as his own offspring.

title: Kodi
desc: Twins Kodi and Anbu have different personalities. Though one is into politics, the other is a pacifist. But a twist in the twins' fates causes one to adopt the other's life and seek revenge.

title: Kathavarayan
desc: Kathavarayan, an illegal liquor dealer, faces trouble when a student, who vows to expose those who flout the laws, gets him arrested.

title: Pavalakodi
desc: Shiva, who loves Paval since their school days, hires Robert, a detective, to find her whereabouts. However, things take a turn when Robert falls for her and lies to Shiva about her marital status.

title: Deiva Vaakku
desc: Hamsaveni's divine power earns her respect among the villagers, whereas her brother, Vallatharai, tries to exploit her power for his personal gain. He goes to the extent of sabotaging her marriage.
